1: # KNIRVCONTROLLER Mobile Refactor Plan
2: 
3: Tracks remaining work to bring the Android and iOS builds to feature parity with the web app.
4: Capacitor scaffolding and the release pipeline are already in place — this document picks up from there.
5: 
6: ---
7: 
8: ## What's Already Shipped
9: 
10: | Area | Status | Notes |
11: |---|---|---|
12: | Capacitor foundation | ✅ Done | `android/`, `ios/`, `capacitor.config.ts` |
13: | Android signing | ✅ Done | `build.gradle` reads `KNIRV_ANDROID_*` env vars; debug keystore auto-generated in `build/signing/` |

24: ## Remaining Work
25: 
26: ### 1  Wire native voice into `useVoiceIntegration`
27: **Files:** `src/react-app/hooks/useVoiceIntegration.ts`
28: 
29: `@capgo/capacitor-speech-recognition` and `@capacitor-community/text-to-speech` are installed but `useVoiceIntegration.ts` still simulates STT/TTS with `setTimeout`. The real wiring is missing.
30: 
31: Create `src/react-app/platform/voiceBridge.ts`:
32: 
33: ```ts
34: import { Capacitor } from '@capacitor/core';
35: import { SpeechRecognition } from '@capgo/capacitor-speech-recognition';
36: import { TextToSpeech } from '@capacitor-community/text-to-speech';
37: 
38: export async function startNativeListening(onResult: (text: string) => void): Promise<void> {
39:   const { speechRecognition } = await SpeechRecognition.requestPermissions();
40:   if (speechRecognition !== 'granted') throw new Error('Microphone permission denied');
41:   await SpeechRecognition.start({ language: 'en-US', maxResults: 1, partialResults: true, popup: false });
42:   await SpeechRecognition.addListener('partialResults', (data) => {
43:     if (data.matches?.[0]) onResult(data.matches[0]);
44:   });
45: }
46: 
47: export async function stopNativeListening(): Promise<void> {
48:   await SpeechRecognition.stop();
49:   await SpeechRecognition.removeAllListeners();
50: }
51: 
52: export async function speakNative(text: string): Promise<void> {
53:   await TextToSpeech.speak({ text, lang: 'en-US', rate: 0.9, pitch: 1.0, volume: 1.0 });
54: }
55: ```
56: 
57: Then in `useVoiceIntegration.ts`, replace the simulated `toggleVoice` and `speakResponse` with:
58: 
59: ```ts
60: import { Capacitor } from '@capacitor/core';
61: import { startNativeListening, stopNativeListening, speakNative } from '@/react-app/platform/voiceBridge';
62: 
63: // In toggleVoice:
64: if (Capacitor.isNativePlatform()) {
65:   if (active) await startNativeListening(handleVoiceCommand);
66:   else await stopNativeListening();
67: } else {
68:   // existing Web Speech API path
69: }
70: 
71: // In speakResponse:
72: if (Capacitor.isNativePlatform()) {
73:   await speakNative(text);
74: } else {
75:   // existing window.speechSynthesis path
76: }
77: ```

81: ### 2  Persistent native storage for vault and app settings
82: **Files:** `src/react-app/hooks/useVault.ts`, `src/react-app/hooks/useAppSettings.ts`, `src/react-app/platform/browserStorage.ts`, `src/react-app/platform/vaultHandoff.ts`
83: 
84: #### 2a  Install `@capacitor/preferences`
85: ```bash
86: npm install @capacitor/preferences
87: npx cap sync
88: ```
89: 
90: #### 2b  Create `src/react-app/platform/nativeStorage.ts`
91: ```ts
92: import { Capacitor } from '@capacitor/core';
93: import { Preferences } from '@capacitor/preferences';
94: 
95: // Drop-in replacement for localStorage / sessionStorage calls.
96: // On web falls through to the existing browserStorage helpers.
97: export const nativeStorage = {
98:   async get(key: string): Promise<string | null> {
99:     if (Capacitor.isNativePlatform()) {
100:       const { value } = await Preferences.get({ key });
101:       return value;
102:     }
103:     return localStorage.getItem(key);
104:   },
105:   async set(key: string, value: string): Promise<void> {
106:     if (Capacitor.isNativePlatform()) {
107:       await Preferences.set({ key, value });
108:     } else {
109:       localStorage.setItem(key, value);
110:     }
111:   },
112:   async remove(key: string): Promise<void> {
113:     if (Capacitor.isNativePlatform()) {
114:       await Preferences.remove({ key });
115:     } else {
116:       localStorage.removeItem(key);
117:     }
118:   },
119: };
120: ```
121: 
122: #### 2c  Update `useVault.ts` — four call sites
123: Replace every `localStorage.getItem(VAULT_STORAGE_KEY)` / `localStorage.setItem(...)` / `localStorage.removeItem(...)` with `await nativeStorage.get/set/remove(...)`.
124: The initial `checkStorage` `useEffect` must be made async for this. No other logic changes.
125: 
126: #### 2d  Update `browserStorage.ts` — add async native path
127: `readStorageItem` / `writeStorageItem` / `removeStorageItem` are used by `useAppSettings` and `vaultHandoff`. Add overloads that accept a `native?: boolean` flag (driven by `Capacitor.isNativePlatform()`) and delegate to `nativeStorage`.  
128: **`vaultHandoff.ts`** currently uses `sessionStorage` — on native, `session` scope should map to in-memory state (session scoped storage has no native equivalent; the handoff payload is ephemeral by design, so an in-memory map is correct).
129: 
130: #### 2e  Future hardening: Keychain / Keystore
131: After the base adapter ships, swap `Preferences` for `@aparajita/capacitor-secure-storage` on the native path. The vault blob is already AES-encrypted by `knirvwallet-module`, so this adds a second layer: iOS Keychain with `.whenUnlockedThisDeviceOnly` + biometric unlock, Android Keystore with StrongBox.

135: ### 3  Vite WebView asset path fix
136: **File:** `vite.config.ts`
137: 
138: Without `base: './'`, Vite emits absolute asset paths (e.g. `/assets/index-abc.js`) that resolve against the WebView origin but break when the bundle is loaded from the local filesystem. Add to the `build:` block:
139: 
140: ```ts
141: build: {
142:   target: 'esnext',
143:   chunkSizeWarningLimit: 5000,
144:   base: './',   // required for Capacitor WebView
145: },
146: ```
147: 
148: Verify with `npm run build && npx cap sync` — all JS/CSS hrefs in `dist/index.html` should start with `./`.

152: ### 4  Safe area insets and viewport config
153: **Files:** `index.html`, `src/react-app/components/Layout.tsx`
154: 
155: iOS notch and home-indicator devices clip the fixed header and bottom nav without `viewport-fit=cover`.
156: 
157: **`index.html`** — replace the viewport meta:
158: ```html
159: <!-- before -->
160: <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
161: 
162: <!-- after -->
163: <meta name="viewport" content="viewport-fit=cover, width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0" />
164: ```
165: 
166: **`Layout.tsx`** — add `style` props to the fixed header and bottom nav:
167: ```tsx
168: // Fixed header
169: <header
170:   className="..."
171:   style={{ paddingTop: 'env(safe-area-inset-top)' }}
172: >
173: 
174: // Bottom nav

183: ### 5  Capacitor plugin polish (status bar, haptics, keyboard, back button)
184: 
185: Install remaining Capacitor core plugins:
186: ```bash
187: npm install @capacitor/app @capacitor/haptics @capacitor/keyboard @capacitor/status-bar @capacitor/splash-screen
188: npx cap sync
189: ```
190: 
191: **Status bar** — add to `capacitor.config.ts` plugins block:
192: ```ts
193: plugins: {
194:   SplashScreen: { launchAutoHide: false, backgroundColor: '#08111f', showSpinner: false },
195:   StatusBar: { style: 'Dark', backgroundColor: '#08111f', overlaysWebView: false },
196: },
197: ```

199: **Android back button** — create `src/react-app/platform/backHandler.ts`:
200: ```ts
201: import { App } from '@capacitor/app';
202: import { Capacitor } from '@capacitor/core';
203: 
204: export function registerBackHandler(onBack: () => boolean) {
205:   if (!Capacitor.isNativePlatform()) return () => {};
206:   const listener = App.addListener('backButton', () => {
207:     if (!onBack()) App.exitApp();
208:   });
209:   return () => { listener.then(l => l.remove()); };
210: }
211: ```
212: Call from `Layout.tsx` — wire to `navigate(-1)`; return `false` (triggering `exitApp`) only when already at the root.
213: 
214: **Haptic feedback** — wrap in `Capacitor.isNativePlatform()` guard; add to:
215: - Vault creation success → `Haptics.impact({ style: ImpactStyle.Medium })`
216: - Transaction confirmed → `Haptics.impact({ style: ImpactStyle.Heavy })`
217: - Error states → `Haptics.notification({ type: NotificationStyle.Error })`

219: **Keyboard** — add to `src/react-app/main.tsx`:
220: ```ts

222: if (Capacitor.isNativePlatform()) {
223:   Keyboard.setResizeMode({ mode: 'body' });
224: }
225: ```

254: ### 7  Bluetooth permissions for Ledger (Android manifest)
255: **File:** `android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`
256: 
257: CAMERA and RECORD_AUDIO are already present. Ledger BLE support (Phase 8 below) requires:
258: ```xml
259: <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.BLUETOOTH" />
260: <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.BLUETOOTH_CONNECT" />
261: <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.BLUETOOTH_SCAN" />
262: <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION" />
263: ```
264: Add these now so store review is not re-triggered later.
265: 
266: iOS Bluetooth usage string should also be added to `Info.plist`:
267: ```xml
268: <key>NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription</key>
269: <string>KNIRV Controller uses Bluetooth to connect Ledger hardware wallets.</string>
270: ```

274: ### 8  Ledger BLE bridge (advanced, deferrable)
275: 
276: `@ledgerhq/hw-transport-webhid` uses WebHID — unavailable in any mobile WebView. Requires a custom Capacitor plugin wrapping the native Ledger Device SDKs.
277: 
278: **New files:**
279: ```
280: src/capacitor-plugins/ledger-ble/definitions.ts    — plugin TS interface
281: src/capacitor-plugins/ledger-ble/index.ts          — registerPlugin('LedgerBLE')
282: src/react-app/platform/ledgeBleTransport.ts        — getLedgerTransport() returning CapacitorLedgerTransport on native
283: android/.../LedgerBLEPlugin.java                   — wraps com.ledger.devicesdk:ledger-device-sdk
284: ios/.../LedgerBLEPlugin.swift                      — wraps LedgerDeviceKit via Swift Package Manager
285: ```
286: 
287: The plugin exposes `scan()`, `connect({ deviceId })`, `disconnect()`, `exchange({ apdu: string })` — enough for `@ledgerhq/hw-app-cosmos` to drive the full signing flow.
288: All wallet signing logic in `knirvwallet-module/` is pure TypeScript and requires no changes.
289: 
290: **Can ship Phases 1–7 without this.** Ledger BLE is a follow-on sprint.

294: ### 9  CI/CD pipelines
295: **Missing:** `.github/` directory does not yet exist under KNIRVCONTROLLER.
296: 
297: The `release-native.mjs` script handles local builds. GitHub Actions workflows are needed for automated builds on push and pull requests.
298: 
299: Create `.github/workflows/build-android.yml` and `.github/workflows/build-ios.yml`.
300: 
301: **`build-android.yml`** — trigger: push to `main` touching `packages/KNIRVCONTROLLER/**`
302: - `ubuntu-latest` runner
303: - `actions/setup-node@v4` (Node 20) + `actions/setup-java@v4` (Java 17, Temurin)
304: - `npm ci` → `npm run build` (inject `VITE_*` from secrets) → `npx cap sync android`
305: - Decode `KNIRV_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_FILE` from `ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64` secret
306: - `./gradlew assembleRelease` → copy `app-release.apk` → `actions/upload-artifact@v4`
307: - On `main`: upload AAB (`./gradlew bundleRelease`) to Play Store Internal via `r0adkll/upload-google-play@v1`
308: 
309: Required secrets: `ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64`, `KNIRV_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD`, `KNIRV_ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS`, `KNIRV_ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD`, `VITE_API_URL`, `VITE_XION_RPC_URL`, `VITE_KNIRV_CHAIN_ID`, `PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON`
310: 
311: **`build-ios.yml`** — trigger: same
312: - `macos-14` runner (Apple Silicon, Xcode 15)
313: - `npm ci` → `npm run build` → `npx cap sync ios`
314: - Import signing cert via `apple-actions/import-codesign-certs@v2`
315: - Import provisioning profile via `apple-actions/download-provisioning-profiles@v1`
316: - `xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App archive`
317: - `xcodebuild -exportArchive` with `ios/ExportOptions.plist`
318: - On `main`: upload IPA to TestFlight via `apple-actions/upload-testflight-build@v1`
319: 
320: Required secrets: `IOS_CERTIFICATE_BASE64`, `IOS_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD`, `APPLE_ISSUER_ID`, `APPLE_API_KEY_ID`, `APPLE_API_PRIVATE_KEY`, `APPLE_TEAM_ID`
321: 
322: Create `ios/ExportOptions.plist`:
323: ```xml
324: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
325: <!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
326: <plist version="1.0"><dict>
327:   <key>method</key><string>app-store</string>
328:   <key>teamID</key><string>YOUR_TEAM_ID</string>
329:   <key>signingStyle</key><string>manual</string>
330:   <key>uploadBitcode</key><false/>
331:   <key>uploadSymbols</key><true/>
332: </dict></plist>
333: ```
334: 
335: Note: the current `release-native.mjs` uploads to `incline:knirv/controller/` via `rclone`. The CI workflows above target Play Store / TestFlight directly. Both paths can coexist — local `npm run release:mobile` for ad-hoc distribution, CI for store submission.

339: ### 10  E2E testing (Maestro)
